lines: Haya ang bujinw ma maya bi;

title: Bese gedert onnai O Iswr Apha

lines: Bese gedert onnai O Iswr Apha,
Diya dokhlayabw slim slam lama jagwn.
Khwmsiao srangkhou hwnw, San badi jwngblaonanwi;
Ayo! Swrgwni Swranga, Be hayaonw nujaphwigwn.
Ayo! Swrgwni gwthanga, Be hayaonw nujaphwigwn.
Ayo! Swrgwni gwjwnnai, Be hayaonw nujaphwigwn.
Gusu sudem bara bardwng, somaina romaina,
Bikhou hambai hwn Nwngni gwsw jiujwng.
Phwrbu jwi jathwng, swrgwniphrai duth phwidwng,
Sigang sigang hathorkhi, un un gwnwkhphwr,
Thangnangdwng hajw ar dwima dwi barnanwi,

title: Dinwi Bwswr Gwdan, Jwngha jiu gwdan

lines: Dinwi Bwswr Gwdan, Jwngha jiu gwdan,
Phwi jwngw rongjani gwdan gwdan dinwi,
Iswr-ni onnaijwng mwnbai jwng Bwswr gwdan;
Onnaijwngnw hwdw jwngnw bwr ar bwlw
Hasar mwnnanwi bilai gwdanjwng bithai thai,

title: Phiri phiri bwthwra, Bere rungnai badi

lines: Phiri phiri bwthwra, Bere rungnai badi,
Aros gabw jwng dinwi boibw Nwngniao,
Dwidenlangdw Nwngw jwngkhou nwi be bwswrao.
Bi badi gurai lwgw ar gwia,
Jisu badi raobw gwia be songsarao,
Angni phap'khou mwnsebw lanw haya raobw.
O angni gwsw, Jisu-ni athing hom,
Biw jwngni phap'khounw, Gaoni sayao layw.
Ang thangnaijwng nonga, nwng thangnaijwng nonga,
Angni bwthwr nonga, nwngni bwthwr nonga,
Gwhw khalamdw nwng, garnai nonga nwngkhou,
Ginw nanga nwng, Binw lwgwao dong.
Jisu-a langphagwn, Gaoni un un angkhou;
Angni jiua bungw  Angni mogon nuyw;
Thu jwng Jisu-ni un un thangni.
Hengtha dongo, jingsi dongo, rojong dongo,
Hengtha dongo, jingsi dongo, rojong dongo,
Thwini ort hwbai angnw gedert srang,
Basainw thakhwi Biw gaoni jiu hwbai.
Nwngni onnaikhou, bikhou ang baonw haya.
Ang baonw haya, ang baonw haya.
Phwrbu Iswr-khou nwng man hwnw nanggou.
Ayo! Phwrbu Nwngni onnaialai bese gwthou!
Ayo! Phwrbu Nwngni onnaialai bese gwthou!
Ayo! Phwrbu Nwngni onnaialai bese gwthou!
Gedert undwi boibw lamayao hi bodwng,
Haoria mansiphra dalai bodwng. O Phwrbu.
Jisu raja, Jisu raja Biw phwiphingwn,
Khijur bilai badi onnai Binw banaihw,
Nwngni gwsw duar-khou mabar kheonan hw.
Nwngni mwjang onnai badi Binw banaihw,
Mansiphra rongja baja, Dalai ar hiphwrkhou,
Rongjadw boibw mansiphwr, Jisu-ni Jwi hwdw,
Sana hoa maobai biswr ese gedert daikhou,
O Thomas nwngw angni khathiao phwi,
Bi phwibla nwng Bijwng thangnw tham thim jadw.
Bi phwiblanw Bijwng thangnw tham thim jadw.
Nwngni jiua tham thim nenan thagwn na ?
O bida phongbai, danw tham thim ja,
Phwrbu Iswr mabwrwi lanw hanw anglai,
Bwi honwi, bwi phwigwn jwbnaini mugayao.
Thangphanw raobw haya, Jwngjwng raobw haya.
Madi jagwn jwnghalai jiua bwi somao.
Tham thim janan thakhadw danw be somao.
Siri mwnnan thakhadw danw jwng boibw.
Sannw gwrwng saba sikhla badi jananwi,
Siri mwnnan tha dinwi gaswi mansi,
Thakha mai no' bangkhou bungdwng angni
Sase benggra Iswr dongo jwngni gejerao.
Gwswao dwn Jisu bungnai, onnai manikhou.
Bipha, Bisa, Gwthar Jiu-a, negwn jwngkhou.
Gajri biphang gajri bithai thainaikhou sinai.
Swmw nangthao biw maogwn bikhou daphwthai.
Hani thingwi angha bangsin gwsw dong.
Gole gole phap'ao gadwi layw ang,
Mwnnai nonga bidijwng, Swrgw raijwkhou jwng,
Mwnnai nonga bidijwng, Swrgw raijwkhou jwng,
Swmw nangthao mwjang bathra Baibel-a bungw.
Mwia dinwi ar lagarbw, Jisu thaphlaiyw;
Sagwrni barkhou hompthayw, Bi oraibw dong.
Mwia, dinwi ar lagarbw, Jisu thaphlaiyw,
Biniao khema bidw nwng, gurwi gwswjwng;
Angbw nwngkhou dai homlia, thangdw gwjwnwi.
Bwr gwnang khalam aros gabw ang,
Bwr gwnang khalam O Phwrbu angkhou.
Gwkhrwi srang jathwng ! Gwkhrwi srang jathwng !
Jwng siri mwnni! Jwng siri mwnni!
O Jisu Nwngni raijwkhou gwkhrwi hort.
Be khwmsi hayao srang jathwng hwnnanwi,
Srangkhou hwni jwng be, Khwmsi songsarao,
Nwngni jaigayao Nwng, Ar angniao ang.
Ou binikhainw srangkhou, Jeraobw hwthardw de.
O boibw mansiphwr, nwngswrw mithidw de.
O angni bisaphwr, nwngswrw sakhi hwdw.
O angni bisaphwr, lagarbw siri mwndw.
Hama matha ang, Nwng dw' dagra.
Ma banainw Nwng tham thim khalam.
Jadw Nwng angni mijingk, O Phwrbu,
Nwng angni sapsin simang. San horao;
Jadw Nwng angni gyan O nwnggou Bathra,
Nwng angni Bipha, Ang Nwngni bica.
Nwng Angkhou onw ang Nwngni onjalu.
Gwsw hwa ang dhwn, sonsra bathra'ao,
Nwng angni gudi, da ar jeblaibw,
Nwng ar Nwnglo. Gibi angni jiuao.
Swrgwni raja Nwng, O derha hwgra,
Jekhi jathwng angha, Nwng angni mijink.
Gwjwn jaigao habnw nwng gwsw ne ?
Jwnggwn ne hathorkhi angni khoro sayao ?
Jwnggwn ne hathorkhi, angni khoro sayao
Bese rongjagwn ang, mwkhang nubla Bini,
O sannw rwngwi nwrkhwao manw thangnw ?
Bi mwjang hadorao bikha khamnai gwia,
Thudw, thudw thangphadw da khabu dongo,
Gosongdwng ang pheleng jaywi bi borsayao,
Susranggra gwgw ar gwthar, Krus-ni thwiao,
Ang jeraobw harsing nonga Jisu dong,
Wi Kristo-ni rwn nanggraphwr sikhangdw de
Wi Kristo-ni rwn nanggraphwr, janji khaphra
Wi Kristo-ni rwn nanggraphwr, naigirdw de
Khwmsiao hathai ornai gabnaiphwr gwbang dong.
Khwmsini raja gajri jiu, Switanjwng rwn hwdw.
Jwngni rwn nangnaia, Bedorjwng thwijwng nonga.
Nongoujwng janjikhou, Phrat phrit khananwi gosongdw de,
Dhwrwmni phangthegra bikhayao, khananwi ladw nwng.
Khwthabainaini tham thim-khou, athingao phannanwi la',
Basainai thupikhou khoroao, oraibw khwbnanwi la'.
Jisu-ni thunggri najao, Iswr-ni gaham bathra.
Gaonw dwiden dwiden langnw swrgw raijwao.
Bikha sou-wi, sou-wi gabnw nanggwn jwng goa.
Nongkhai sandw be hakhou de jwngni lwgw,
Manwthw derga japhwidwng nwng be mulugao.
Naidwng manw bima, bipha, bida phongbaiphwr,
Andaibai ang hayaoni man sonman naigirnanwi,
Hadri badi uraidwng ang maya hayaonw,
Jadwng lwngdwng rongjadwng wi angni jiu,
Nathai Jisu-a hwnbai nwngha dinwinw jwpbai.
Tham thim khalam boibw gaoni jiukhou.
Ayou! hathai ortnai gabnai jagwn bi mugayao,
Phwidw Bikhainw jwng sibidwni, Jiuni Rajakhou,
Wi Kristo lwgw siri mwndw, Jiuni lamayao,
Gwkhrwi thangw honwi gwthangni gusung din,
Jubra ang da jiu ar mwdwmao,
Phwrbu Jisu-jwng thangphanw tham thim jadw.
Gajri phap phwrkhou Biw nainw haya.
Ma esegrap' gwdwi bathra, O Phwrbu,
Sangra, onkho, nonggou gwsw gwnang ja,
Grit grit thanggwn jwng phari phari.

title: La, la, la, la, la, la

lines: La, la, la, la, la, la
Birjap', khouse ja, Kristo-ni mungkhou lananwi,
Hangkhrai Kristo-khou gaoni jiuni lwgw khalam.
Sona ruphajwng somai hwblabw, jiua gwiabwla,
Gwsw singaoni gwdan subunga nwngniao gwiabwla.
Dhwrwm thablabw, khwrwm thablabw, jiua gwiabwla,
Bini onnaianw dwimu badi, Bahai dwimu badi.
Tham thim jadw gwkhwrwi gao gaoni jiuao.
Jwngw naigirbla, Jiuni lamakhou mwngwn jwng.
Jiuni bodol nwng da ma hwphingwn ?
Bhagw mwnbai nama nwng jiuao asa.
Oh! Phapi gwswkhoulo hwnw hagwn ang,
jwng gia, jwng gia, jwng gia.
Be dinsim angni bathra ar maonaiphra,
Ar angbw dongo barse bibar badi
Nwng badi swr lama dinthigra dong ?
Khwmsi hakhorao Nwng angnw srang hw;
Rongja baja raijw jadw de guli guli.
Un sigangao bengnan dong, Biw onnaikhai.
Iswr-ni maonaia swmw nangthao habap' baidi-mwia,
Hambai hwnw baknaijathwng Apha Nwngni munga.
Maoria haoria alangba Boro gothophwr jwng,
Iswr Apha sorjapbai da nwngswr sanwikhou.
Dukh arw sukhao hephajabkhou mwngwn thwinaisim.
Gwswao dong Jisu onnai bungni bathrakhou,
Jingga sinai dukhu jwpgwn, gwjwnnai phwigwn.
Gaoni hanai badi, Gwsw janai badi,
Ma janw jwngw ma lwngnw jwngw ?
Nwng gaoni bisakhou angnw dan horbai,
Bini mungwi ang Nwngnw ma hwphinnw ?
Najao Phwrbu angni be undwi dankhou.
Bwr hwdw Phwrbu Nwng ang phapikhounw.
Gwsw jagwn bwkhangjanw boibw, gwsw jagwn.
Gapnai phwigwn, phwthainai gwiabla, gapnai phwigwn.
Akhaiao dong, bwkhangphinnw, garnw, akhaiao dong
Okha naisi naisi gwsw dorsi ayo !
Mwdwi rukhu rukhu mani dukhu ayo !
Nokhrang naidao naidao ha' phisa houa,
Daosen daola gaswi siri mwnbai ayo!
Alai silai jwngw khonsaidw Apha Iswr.
Dukhu mwnw hangma suyw, bidaini somao.
Baodw boibw dukhu mwnnaikhou bidaini somao.
Danw jwngw ongkharnwswi gao gaoni no'ao.
Sanse jwngw lwgw mwnjlaigwn Iswr onnaijwng,
Nathai jwngha dinwilai bidaini som jabai.
O jebla ang phap'aomwn, Jisu bwkhangbai,
O jebla ang khwiphwdaomwn, Jisu bwkhangbai,
Jebla ang khwmsiaomwn, Jisu srang hwbai.
O jebla ang khwmsiaomwn, Jisu srang hwbai,
::Nwngni onnaia, biw gedert dan, Jwbnw gwia biw.::
Thangdwni phwi jwng Bini un un.

title: O Afa angkhou Nwng da nagar
